ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rhombus $ABCD$, $AB=13$ and $AC=10$, what is the length of $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus,\\
hence BD = 2OB, AC = 2OA, and AC $\perp$ BD,\\
therefore OA = 5, and $\angle$AOB = 90$^\circ$\\
In right $\triangle$AOB, $BO = \sqrt{AB^{2}-OA^{2}} = \sqrt{13^{2}-5^{2}} = 12$\\
therefore BD = $2 \times 12 = \boxed{24}$.
